About Our College
Established with a vision to provide quality education, Tihu College has been a beacon of knowledge and innovation for over six decades.
Tihu College has been one of the premier institutions of higher education in Assam. Having trodden 63 years of spreading illumination in society, the college has celebrated its Golden Jubilee in March, 2013 last. Tihu College was established on a very auspicious day, July 04,1963, fulfilling the dream of acquiring quality higher education for the people, inculcated by a group of illustrious personalities with support from the rural masses of greater Tihu area. Under the dynamic leadership with relentless and untiring efforts of Late Sailendra Prasad Medhi, the founder Principal of the College, it grew into one of the premier rural institutions imparting education right from HS to TDC level. The College has come across a long way with more than five decades of eventful history behind it catering to the needs of the students opting for higher education in the greater Tihu, Namati, Baksa, Khetri and Dharmapur areas of Nalbari, Baksa and Barpeta districts of Assam.
